title: Bind Pullback Learning to explicit suspended eligibility owner
objective: Implement the already-authorized framework-owner suspension in the existing adaptive Pullback Learning owner. Replace the impossible dependency on GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE with a fail-closed read of 04_MARKET_LEARNING/pullback_learning/ELIGIBILITY_STATUS_v1.json. While status is SUSPENDED_NO_ELIGIBILITY_CONTRACT, continue immutable observation collection and descriptive adaptive statistics, emit REGIME_NOT_ACTIVE with explicit ELIGIBILITY_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE reason, create no new pullback/reload research episodes, do not mature or mutate existing episodes, and preserve all research-only/no-portfolio/no-canonical authority boundaries. This task implements an existing owner decision; it must not invent or infer any new eligibility rule, threshold, market state, rebuy permission or portfolio action.
allowed_change_scope: tests/pullback_learning/directly related suspension, liveness, episode-freeze and authority tests
04_MARKET_LEARNING/pullback_learning/ELIGIBILITY_STATUS_v1.json only for non-semantic formatting/contract-consumption corrections; do not change permissions or resume criteria

evidence.summary: Framework owner explicitly suspends mechanical research classification and episode creation/maturation while allowing observation collection and descriptive statistics; legacy entry, breadth and direction confidence have no eligibility role.
Current classify() still uses GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE as the prerequisite and update_episode() has no independent suspension guard.
Pullback v0.2 remains GUIDANCE_ONLY and mechanical classification authority is suspended until a complete source-backed specification exists.

Fresh audit found no pre-existing legitimate research-only eligibility owner and correctly escalated rather than substituting proxy breadth, source quality, T12 or direction confidence. The new framework-owner status resolves that missing contract by explicitly suspending classification, not by creating permission.
Current owner has zero closed episodes and INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, supporting suspension rather than invention of a new rule.

reproduction: On fresh main after the framework-owner status is merged, confirm ELIGIBILITY_STATUS_v1.json exists with status SUSPENDED_NO_ELIGIBILITY_CONTRACT, observation_collection=true, mechanical_research_classification=false, new_episode_creation=false and existing_episode_maturation=false. Confirm pullback_learning_ledger.py still depends on GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE and does not consume the status owner. Implement only the binding to that explicit owner. Stop as clean no-op if a newer current-main implementation already does so without changing semantics.

positive: With a valid suspended eligibility status and valid fresh hourly/breadth inputs, a new immutable observation is still written and adaptive descriptive statistics continue, while research_state remains REGIME_NOT_ACTIVE and evidence explicitly records ELIGIBILITY_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE / SUSPENDED_NO_ELIGIBILITY_CONTRACT.
When classification and episode permissions are false, update logic cannot create a new PULLBACK_RISK/PULLBACK_ACTIVE/RELOAD episode and cannot mutate or mature an existing open episode.

LATEST and STATE preserve explicit research_only=true, portfolio_execution=false, canonical_market_state=false and automatic_rule_changes=false authority, and DATA PING bridge wording makes the suspension visible rather than implying a market call.
Duplicate price observations remain deduplicated exactly as before and historical observation/episode files are not rewritten.
negative: GRADUATED_ALTCOIN_TOPUP_ACTIVE, proxy breadth, canonical_compatible source quality, T12 or direction confidence cannot override SUSPENDED_NO_ELIGIBILITY_CONTRACT.
Missing, malformed or authority-incompatible ELIGIBILITY_STATUS_v1.json fails closed: no mechanical classification and no episode mutation; do not silently fall back to the retired entry gate.
Do not add any numeric eligibility, pullback, breadth, ETHBTC, BTC.D or regime threshold.
Do not create a new pullback engine, rebuy permission, canonical market state, portfolio action or automatic rule promotion.
Do not alter historical observations/episodes/outcomes or manufacture closed episodes.

forbidden_changes: changing ELIGIBILITY_STATUS_v1 permissions or resume criteria
clean_noop_condition: A newer current-main implementation already consumes ELIGIBILITY_STATUS_v1 correctly with observation liveness, classification suspension, episode freeze and authority firewall intact, or the adaptive Pullback Learning owner has been explicitly retired/superseded.
stop_condition: Stop without code changes if the owner status is absent, its permissions/resume criteria differ from the submitted candidate, candidate hash/status/authority changes, reproduction no longer confirms the stale retired-entry dependency, or implementation would require changing the owner decision rather than consuming it.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if implementation requires changing ELIGIBILITY_STATUS_v1 permissions/resume criteria, introducing any new eligibility or market threshold, granting rebuy/canonical/portfolio authority, or modifying Pullback Policy v0.2 semantics.
